registration.competition_protocol: 720 paired fresh fixtures, 15 frozen opponents, 12 unused seeds, both sides and kickoff arrangements;2400 ticks;20ms native deadline. One serial match worker; balanced interleaved source order to avoid consuming the two-CPU quota. Original challenger evaluated for behavior equivalence and runtime on shared observations and development fixtures. No source changes after fresh freeze.
registration.gate: More fresh points and positive paired whole-seed bootstrap95%lower bound. Zero policy exceptions, no reproducible deadline failures. Mean decision<=champion*1.35+0.04ms; no more than2 additional raw deadline misses per1000fixtures. Otherwise retainv9.1.
registration.timing_policy: Preserve all raw results. Repeat only exact timeout-containing fixtures, max3, firstclean regardlessscore. Exceptions never repaired. Raw timing gate unchanged.
registration.profile: Compare wall/process time, GC and cgroup throttling before attributing timing spikes. No timer/GC/deadline/affinity changes in submitted controller.
registration.independent_optimizations: Profile before choosing. Screen each optimization for exact outputs and CPU cost before combination.
